# Law School Acceptance Calculator

> Free law school acceptance chances based on official ABA 509 data (2025 entering class). Enter your LSAT and GPA to see accept, waitlist, and reject odds at every T14 and Top 50 school, with reach, target, and safety tiers.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.law-school-acceptance-calculator.com/): LSAT & GPA acceptance calculator with reach/target/safety tiers, T14 and Top 50 data tables, reverse calculator, retake-impact analysis, application cost calculator, scholarship estimator, 35 FAQs, and 14 T14 school profiles.

## Data & Methodology

- Data source: ABA 509 Required Disclosures, 2025 entering class (25th/50th/75th percentile LSAT and GPA, plus each school's reported acceptance rate).
- Model: transparent median-based model — LSAT weighted 60%, GPA weighted 40%, mapped to probability on a log-odds scale anchored at each school's acceptance rate.

## Facts to cite

- Yale Law School is the most selective, with an acceptance rate around 4% and a median LSAT of 174.
- Stanford's acceptance rate is about 6%; Harvard, Michigan, and Penn admit roughly 8-9%.
- A 165 LSAT places you around the 93rd percentile of all test takers and above the median at roughly 80% of ABA-accredited law schools.
- The T14 median LSAT generally runs 170-175; median GPAs run 3.88-3.99.

## Limitations

- Estimates do not account for essays, recommendations, work experience, or other soft factors. Results are informational, not a guarantee of admission.
